composition_contract.arithmetic: All raw interpolation/decode arithmetic executes pinned ref_core Fpu. No host binary64 sampling, quaternion normalization, time clamping or stream-sentinel invention.
composition_contract.errors: Finite original ValueError/HostFault/IndexError retain completed writes and list rotations; native-only resource caps/foreign identities are tested separately.
composition_contract.identity: Original decode_clip Track construction is instrumented only to retain its stable owner identity on success or failure; no original numerical or branch body is replaced.
composition_contract.publication: Sibling temporary files flushed and fsynced, fixture replaced then manifest last. Interrupted pair publication is detectable by hashes, not a two-file transaction.
composition_contract.scope: Standalone original Clip, DecoderPool, animtrack_decode, joint_pos/joint_quat and decode_clip. No clock advancement, root/yaw extraction, pose, sound, UI or Session integration.
composition_contract.state: Complete owned clip metadata/bytes/words, stable track IDs, every64x16 joint slot record, slot owner/clip/cursor/tick/yaw and LRU. Unused AnimSystem pose/VU/sound fields remain default and outside this API.

input_protocol.commands: 0 add_clip(nameBytes,fileBytes);1 alloc;2 touch(slot);3 decode(track);4 pos(slot,joint,time);5 quat(slot,joint,time);6 decode_clip(clip,time,flags);7 set_track(track,field,value);8 copy_track(dst,src);9 set_event(clip,index,seconds,mask);10 word(clip,index)
input_protocol.identity: Clip/track/slot IDs are 1-based, 0=null; slot.index is 0-based. decode_clip retains a newly constructed track even on failure.
